chapters.text: Everything to do today on one screen: overdue, due today, site visits, callbacks, new leads and hot leads without a next step.
Open CRM → Leads → My day each morning (the morning notification opens it too).
Work from the top: overdue first. Tap the phone or WhatsApp icon to contact the client.
Open the lead to log what happened and plan the next follow-up.
The circle shows how much of today is done.
